what.text: This page follows refugees from Saint Vincent and the Grenadines in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 194 refugees from Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, and the United Kingdom hosted 55.2% of them.
After the United Kingdom, the largest hosts are Canada and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2010 to 2019.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1994 at 7 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 1823, at the end of 2015.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
